event.proposal: Family: parameter tying. Current retained frontier is 1,421 parameters at 99.130000%, a +0.130000 percentage-point margin over 99%. There have been 96 prior macro-attempts in this family and 734 prior micro-trials. The most recent accepted result is attempt-0199/micro-0002 at 1421 parameters and 99.130000%; the most recent failed result is attempt-0194/micro-0002 (discard, 98.910000%). This is a parameterization-preserving compression of the depth-shared feed-forward output map: union flattened coordinates 220 and 9, values 0.0137743028 and 0.0148801170 (difference 1.106e-03), using a weighted mean and integer reconstruction. Hypothesis: residual-stream reconstruction contains near-duplicate scalars distinct from FF-input redundancy, preserving qualification at 1,420 parameters. It is more informative than the next FF-output union (difference 1.129e-03) because it is the minimum-distortion isolated test of the complementary FF map. Official acceptance and rollback are unchanged.
